text.tspan: Human Development Index vs. Corruption Perception Index, 2018
The vertical axis shows scores in the UN Human Development Index (lower values reflect lower development). The horizontal axis shows
scores in Transparency International's Corruption Perception Index (lower values reflect higher perceived corruption).
Data source: UNDP, Human Development Report(2021-22); Transparency International (2018)
